statement: The production settings behind each shipped artifact. These are the arguments the driver was run with; the drivers need the equilibrated parent archives described in data/manifest.json, which this repository does not ship.

campaigns.name: flagship_twin_cone
campaigns.produces: the flagship lambda, front speed v_b and cone ceiling D_sat

campaigns.name: breadth_six_glass_formers
campaigns.audit: scripts/breadth_verify.py, which re-derives every stored u_DW, lambda, D_sat and empirical c from the persisted state files

campaigns.name: confined_film_stationarity_screen
campaigns.role: go/no-go: a film whose cage is still growing over the cone horizon is disqualified before any twin is spent on it

campaigns.name: confined_film_twin_campaign
campaigns.produces: the per-shard twin output that scripts/slab_cone_merge.py merges into results/confinement/slab_cone_merged.json

campaigns.name: matched_kick_bulk_control
campaigns.role: same kick truncation as the narrowest film, no wall frozen, so the boundary is separated from the truncation
